---
title: "Download WEWoS"
---

WEWoS has no release yet. The source is on GitHub:
[github.com/sannerlab/WEWoS](https://github.com/sannerlab/WEWoS).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sannerlab/WEWoS.git
cd WEWoS
bin/wewos check     # lists what is missing
bin/wewos serve     # prints http://127.0.0.1:8767/?t=...  open it in a browser
```

`bin/wewos` needs a Python 3 environment with numpy. The Molecules library also needs MolKit2,
ProDy and mslib, which the `adcpsuite` environment of the [ADCP](../adcp/index.qmd) distribution
provides.

The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. To use it from another machine, forward the port,
`ssh -L 8767:127.0.0.1:8767 host`, then open the printed URL locally.
